status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Kinetic type
summary: Typography takes the lead; motion is an optional accent.
use_when: Use for short messages, campaign headlines, and editorial title sequences.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Large bold system sans-serif headlines; readable sans-serif body.
layout: Oversized heading rhythm, strong line breaks, minimal decoration.
surfaces: Clean solid panels with short optional heading entrance.
exclude: Motion required to understand the message

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Kinetic type to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Large bold system sans-serif headlines; readable sans-serif body. Oversized heading rhythm, strong line breaks, minimal decoration. Clean solid panels with short optional heading entrance. Palette: background #f7f4ed, surface #fffdf8, text #242820, muted #5e6259, accent #755225, border #c9c9bb. Essential traits: Typography-led hierarchy; Deliberate line breaks; Motion limited to headings. Avoid: Animated body text; Reading before text settles; Motion required to understand the message. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
